meta.author: 중복에러방지팀 (duplicate-error-prevention)
meta.purpose: Cross-analyze auto-audit + team-06 task failure patterns; define bounded Circuit-Breaker/Gate rules that block repeated NON-quality errors; independently verify the self-improvement patch (e6efcf1 + INFRA_EXCLUSION) is a real fix and not a fabricated (metric-gamed) improvement.
meta.evidence_source: db/nco.db (T1, direct SQL) + src/core/team-scorer.ts + src/security/circuit-breaker-registry.ts + git
meta.data_availability_note: No dedicated auto-audit *error* log stream is injected/persisted for team-06; data/team-runner/team_quality-audit-*.md are promo-package quality audits of a DIFFERENT team, not team-06 error traces. All figures below are recomputed live from the tasks table. No numbers were invented; absent data is marked 'unavailable'.

repeated_error_finding.hypothesis_from_directive: 동일 FORMAT_MISMATCH 산출물의 무한 재시도 루프가 team-06 실패율을 부풀린다
repeated_error_finding.evidence: SELECT ... LIKE '%FORMAT_MISMATCH%' over team-06 tasks (error||response) = 0 rows across all statuses; reruns of the exact HR-directive prompt = 0. The FORMAT_MISMATCH loop is a report/quality-gate (Stop-hook) layer phenomenon, NOT a persisted task retry storm. A task-level circuit breaker therefore cannot see it; no retry-count metric is fabricated.

rules.rule: Exclude from the terminal (completion denominator) any task whose failure is infra-caused, NOT quality-caused: error LIKE 'orphaned:%' (boot orphan / graceful-shutdown drain), error LIKE 'Circuit breaker open%' (agent offline/rate-limit, iterations=0), OR (status<>'completed' AND error LIKE 'unknown: failure pattern in output%' AND response contains a localhost:6200 connection-refused). Completed and genuine-quality failures (unknown/timeout/lease_expired) are untouched.
rules.safety_invariant: completed ⊆ terminal preserved (double-guarded by status<>'completed'), so completion can never exceed 100%; connection-refused exclusion requires BOTH the failure-class error label AND the response body match, so completed tasks that merely quote a past connection error are not dropped.
rules.rollback: Remove INFRA_EXCLUSION from the 3 terminal CASE blocks (48h/7d/all) → exact prior behavior.

rules.layer: pre-dispatch (prevent the error at source, not just discount it)
rules.target_error_class: gateway-down (curl (7) Failed to connect to localhost port 6200)
rules.rule: Before dispatching a work_report whose target requires an HTTP POST to localhost:6200, probe GET /health once; if unreachable, short-circuit the dispatch with a distinct terminal error 'infra: gateway unreachable (pre-dispatch skip)' instead of letting the agent run and fail. This eliminates the gateway-down failure class at the source rather than excluding it after the fact.
rules.rationale_evidence: 48h global: 13 gateway-down failures across teams; team-06 contributed task_eTYAEfE-U8SP4X8F. These waste an agent run and pollute logs even though R1 already keeps them out of the score.
rules.reversible: Single guarded probe; feature-flag off = current behavior.
rules.risk: Adds one health round-trip per gateway-targeted dispatch; must cache health for a short TTL to avoid probe storms. NOT implemented in this deliverable — proposal only.

rules.rule: The recurring FORMAT_MISMATCH rejection on text-only role/debate deliverables is a grader-format contract mismatch (grader expects 'changed files + diff + build pass'; a debate summary legitimately has none). Recommend the Gap/quality gate classify text-only deliverables separately rather than re-dispatching. No code change made here — flagged for the gate owner. Fabricating a rule-count or a synthetic diff would itself be a false report.
rules.evidence: team-06 persisted FORMAT_MISMATCH tasks = 0; loop lives above the task table.

cross_verification.why_it_moved: Denominator shrank by exactly the 2 verified infra failures (orphan + gateway-down). Numerator (completed=7) is UNCHANGED — no fake completions were added. The 3 lease_expired real failures remain counted.
false_report_reasoning: Improvement comes from removing 2 non-quality failures, each independently verified as infra: task_1SAeDCVf has error 'orphaned: server restart' + 0-length response; task_eTYAEfE response body contains 'Failed to connect to localhost port 6200 ... Couldn''t connect to server' (gateway down — team work never executed).
completed count is identical before/after (7) — the patch does not inflate the numerator.
Genuine-quality failures are preserved: 3 lease_expired NOT excluded.
Safety invariant completed(7) ⊆ terminal(10) holds; no completion>100% regression.
Fix is bounded (single SQL clause) and reversible (git revert / remove INFRA_EXCLUSION).
cross_verification.verification_tier: T1 (direct db/nco.db SQL recompute + source read + git hash)

Runtime score recompute lands on next cron/restart; the stored score row (60.2) may lag the recomputed 70.0% until then.
GATE-06-R2 and R3 are proposals/observations — not implemented or tested in this deliverable.
lease_expired root cause (worker offline) is an availability issue outside this patch's scope.
